title: STNFS with 99.9% ECM, X2 = 2^64, a measured record route, per-survivor recovery and fully reduced LA kernels: 121.4504

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the complete STNFS algorithm in proof.md and DESCENT.md with the numerical refinement and plan re-optimisation in REFINEMENT.md, the 99.9% ECM, X2 = 2^64, theta = 19/50 relation-collection revision (proof.md), the measured record route and the linear-algebra kernels in STORAGE.md and row_tail.c returns Q satisfying e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P, with success at least 0.392133 (and hence at least 0.39) under disclosed heuristics H1-H5 (with H4u: at least 88% of the filtered matrix row weight is +-1 entries, and H4g). It computes two GT logarithms and returns Q=[a]Q0, handling z=1 directly. All classical work is bounded by a global meter at 2^121.4504 dense-Fp12-multiplication equivalents, C=20,000 instructions, with an upper-rounded complete ledger <= 2^121.45029. Main-phase ECM succeeds with 99.9% per prime, the large-prime sieve bound is X2 = 2^64, the collected region is theta=19/50 (1040 canonical rows, a-radius 892) with cofactor slacks (295, 224) and work allowance 1.0675, records of primes in [2^63, 2^64) charged twice, records routed at a measured 10.1 instructions each and recovered only in chunks with a survivor (charged per survivor: re-read chunks are at most the survivors, H4g: a cell's survival is independent of the other records of its chunk), and relation collection is <= 2^121.0986 units. The polynomials, factor-base bound, filtering, kernels and target remain those of the cited source; eight descent-plan entries are re-optimised at the refined quadrature (REFINEMENT.md). Linear algebra (STORAGE.md, row_tail.c: 21 instructions per sparse entry, 2,750 per row for six-limb transfers, combination and the reduction mod r, 97 per dense term, 420 per further 9-limb reduction, N = 1.10 x 0.0471 U, Block Wiedemann blocks (19, 4)) is <= 2^117.7327 units, generator <= 2^107.2082. Expected two-log work is bounded by 2^117.8938; the two-log meter is 2^118.617; Markov abort probability is <= 0.6057524. Other upper bounds are boot failure 1.6385e-4 per log, expected nodes 2^17.58, node abort 2^-9.72 and repeats 2^-10.70, with 2/r statistical distance charged. All preprocessing, failed attempts, advice construction, arithmetic, transfers, sorting, verification and output are included; nothing is amortized over other targets. Numerical-certificate construction receives an extra 2^50-unit allowance. Memory is at most 2^105 bytes. The source smoothness and production extrapolations remain explicit heuristics; no favorable finite-density correction or unsupported independence of whole logarithms is asserted. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Bounded audit of recorded full-recurrence evidence, upward-rounded ledger and success, unchanged prime-window endpoints, and nonzero lower/upper integration controls. Does not rerun the full recurrence.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py) to mean weight 100 and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.88) and U/N. Optional (the hosted initial run is the bounded audit). Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).
Optional full recomputation of certificates, region, ledger, retention, ECM, descent and declared bounds (about 30 s natively; longer when emulated).
